featured_reviews.name: Khushi Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
It is a huge mistake to visit Lakme Absolute Salon. I have been a loyal customer for the past eight years, yet this salon has shown absolutely no respect for long-term customers.

Firstly, Suchita, who has been doing my eyebrows since the beginning, completely ruined them just a day before a wedding we were attending. When we confronted her, instead of apologising or taking accountability, she justified it by saying that she has been doing my eyebrows for so long, as if that alone excused the poor work. Her attitude was casual, dismissive, and unprofessional, which made the situation even more upsetting given the timing and importance of the occasion.

Secondly, the salon misleads customers about their “Happy Hours” offer. The offer is clearly advertised as 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM, Monday to Thursday. We visited on Thursday at 2:00 PM, started our service then, and completed it by 3:30 PM. Despite this, the Happy Hours discount was not applied. When questioned, the staff claimed that the offer is valid only if the bill is generated exactly at 2:00 PM, which was never communicated beforehand and directly contradicts their own stated offer timings.

After so many years of loyalty, it is extremely disappointing to see the salon trying to overcharge customers instead of valuing them. Poor service quality, lack of accountability, misleading offers, and an overall indifferent attitude make this place no longer trustworthy.

I would strongly advise others to think twice before visiting, especially if you expect professionalism, transparency, or basic customer respect.
